messages:
Tara: Quick heads up — we're doing a late cut for v2.4.1. Need a fast green-sweep across any open PRs targeting release/2.4.x. If you have blockers call them out now.
Jason: On it. I'll rebase and rerun CI for my auth fix. ETA ~15m.
ci-bot: Pipeline triggered by Jason / PR #4813 — running full matrix.
Emily: FYI I saw one flaky in integration: test_integration_cache failing intermittently. I can look after my current run finishes.
Kyle: Pushed a tiny bump to the changelog PR (docs only). Tagging @Tara for approvals.
Tara: Thanks @Kyle — can you also add the changelog entry under "Bug fixes" and include the PR number?
Kyle: Yup, done. changelog entry: "Fix race in cache invalidation — #4809"
Marta: Heads up, I still have an in-flight infra change on a feature branch that touches the deploy config. Will hold that off until cut is complete.
Tara: Good call. We want the release branch as minimal as possible.
Jason: ci-bot flagged a flaky test in the mac runner — rerunning the job now.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by Jason — job 4529 requeued.
Emily: I reproduced the cache test locally once — looks like a timing flake where cleanup sometimes lags. I pushed a quick fix with a slightly longer wait in teardown, can we try that in a canary PR?
Tara: Please open a quick PR and mark it "ci: flaky-fix" — we'll run it against the release branch as a canary.
Emily: PR #4820 opened — run matrix requested.
ci-bot: PR #4820 — test matrix started.
Rachel: Quick question: do we want to roll forward the runtime version bump in this cut or defer? The bump improves perf but touches kernels.
Tara: Defer runtime kernel bump to next minor unless it's critical. Keep this cut low-risk.
Rachel: Ack.
Jason: All my jobs are green after rerun. No further changes from my side.
ci-bot: Job 4529 succeeded (mac runner) — all matrix jobs green for Jason/PR #4813.
devops: Noting we have one dedicated capacity pool nearing quota for the release night window. Can we reduce heavy scheduled jobs between 00:00-02:30 UTC to keep capacity headroom?
Tara: Yes — let's mute non-critical nightly jobs during that window. @devops can you post a quick schedule change?
devops: Will do, muting synthetic-load and long-integration nightly jobs between 00:00-03:00 UTC.
Marta: PR #4809 (cache hotfix) merged to release/2.4.x. Bumped version to 2.4.1-rc1 in the branch.
Tara: Nice. Who's doing the final green sweep / smoke after merge?
Jason: I can run the smoke locally and kick a CI smoke job.
Emily: I'll watch the integration runs and triage any leftovers.
ci-bot: Release branch smoke job queued by Jason — job 4601.
ci-bot: Job 4601: smoke tests started.
ci-bot: Job 4601: smoke tests passed.
ci-bot: Full release/2.4.x matrix started (post-merge).
Rachel: One small ask — please pin the canary branch in the console rollout to avoid accidental traffic to rc.
Tara: Done — console rollout pinned to stable only.
Emily: Noting PR #4820 fixed the teardown flake locally; matrix shows green so far.
ci-bot: Matrix for PR #4820 completed: all green.
Marta: Running final changelog generation script and tagging the release candidate.
Jason: Quick git snippet for anyone who needs to re-run locally: ```git fetch origin release/2.4.x && git checkout release/2.4.x && git pull --rebase && ./scripts/run-smoke.sh```
Tara: Thanks Jason. If no blockers by 18:30 UTC we'll mark 2.4.1-rc1 as the release candidate and open the cut checklist.
Emily: No blockers from eng-ml side.
Rachel: No kernel-level changes pending.
Marta: Changelog and tag pushed. Release notes draft in #release-notes.
Tara: Great work everyone — appreciate the quick responses. :thumbsup:
Jason: :rocket:
ci-bot: Final release/2.4.x matrix completed: all jobs passed.
Tara: Marking this thread resolved. If anything pops, reopen or message me directly.
